subject: [PATCH v2 04/17] selftests/mm: retry the swapout the khugepaged swap cases rely on

2026-08-07.patch_summary: This patch modifies the khugepaged selftest to retry swapout operations when they fail due to a best-effort MADV_PAGEOUT call. The test will wait up to two seconds before reporting failure, allowing for occasional failures caused by folios still under writeback from an earlier pageout. This change is intended to improve the reliability of the khugepaged selftest on certain architectures, such as arm64 with 64K pages.
